why: A first CLI battery needs #CLI(Standard) root help, typed subcommands, defaults, ten options, and command-local help.
Exercise Path, create_dir_all, read, append_all, regex, recursive walk, aligned padding, color mode, and ignored fixtures.
Cover argv launch, line streaming, stdin writes, EOF behavior, process.pipeline, receipts, nonzero exits, and bounded consumers.
Feed captured process output through #Codable CSV decoding, data.filter, data.sort_by, and typed field access.
Check Env-backed root fields, child environment overlays, exact exit codes, and success=false receipts.
List and invoke a scheduled #Job, run a top-level single-file script, build --release, install to bin, and smoke the binary.
